observed: The original development profile first ran nine unittest methods, then after moving the same product family from build/product to build/final, current-file execution selected Python Script and more editor warnings were observed by the root agent.
SDK table preserved five existing class roots; global and project workspace caches contained final app typeshed paths. Stdlib unittest/case.py and bundled typeshed unittest/case.pyi existed.

A fresh system/index profile copied only the saved SDK table, opened the same fixture with the same final app and Python 3.14, and the root agent observed native unittest execution of all nine methods and one editor warning.
The copied SDK table initially pointed at old development python_stubs; the updater logged replacement with relocation-control/system/python_stubs.

Final PythonCore fast-loader descriptor exactly matched the intended policy transformation of the original SDK: removing the Pro suggestion provider and Grazie integration. All run/test producer registrations remained.
inferences: The profile state or index/cache contents are a candidate discriminator. The exact component causing the old-profile regression is not yet identified.
ruledOut: The .idea/hello-python.iml MODULE_DIR spelling is valid. The pinned PathMacroUtil.getModuleDir deliberately maps an iml in .idea to its project parent; the workspace JPS reader uses ModulePathMacroManager.
Bundled .pyi stub roots:[] alone does not establish missing stdlib: it occurred in the initially working baseline and the saved SDK contains an explicit typeshed stdlib root.

sourceFindings.finding: The old-path 1310-file report is a false-positive filter group. The source explicitly permits lazy stale membership and fixes membership before logging. This report cannot by itself prove the type/test regression cause.
Persistent filter framing validates format and VFS creation timestamp. Scanner dependency tokens separately govern reuse. A home-path-specific invalidation repair is not justified by this file alone.
MODULE_DIR special-cases an iml stored directly in .idea.
The current workspace reader delegates iml expansion to ModulePathMacroManager.

remaining: Compare read-only diagnostic plugin module membership/SDK/PSI/test-producer reports on old and fresh profiles.
Do not silently delete user caches or modify project roots based on the unproven initial path hypothesis.
A complete application relocation regression and source-correlated durable fix remain open.
